name: port-to-claude
description: Port an existing app's LLM call sites to Claude, with a per-call-site recommendation and a cost/quality delta proven on your own keys.

plugins.name: port-to-claude
plugins.description: Inventories the LLM call sites in a repo, recommends a Claude model per call site, proves the swap with real side-by-side output and a cost delta, and opens a PR containing only the switch.
